title: How much of the bugs came from changes with each warning sign
reading: Each row is a warning sign you can see before a change merges. The bar is the share of all traced bugs that came from changes with that sign. The gray text is how common such changes are. Example, first row: the bot objected to 21% of changes, and those changes produced 63% of the bugs. The first three rows overlap; the last three combine them.
